poc_summary: Scope: evaluate Hosted API for post-purchase chat agent (returns + shipping status) with focus on streaming latency and tool-calling (carrier lookups, order DB queries).

Success criteria: p95 <= 300ms for agent streaming responses under simulated holiday peak (2x baseline concurrency), no functional regressions on tool-calling, cost per session within modeled threshold.
Test plan: day 1 baseline hosted, day 2 synthetic load ramp to 2x, day 3 verify fallback behavior and failover to compatible smaller model; collect token-level cost and per-route latency breakdowns.
Observations so far: p95 sensitive to long tool-call tails; need parallelization of carrier lookups and request hedging. SE recommended response chunking and early partial replies for UX.
Outcome desired: move to Dedicated with reserved capacity for holiday if hosted POC meets p95 and cost targets; else continue optimize layer or hybrid routing.
